mapper.select: select * from tb_second_hand_bargain where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update tb_second_hand_bargain set status = 3, update_time = now() where product_id = #{productId} and deleted = 0 and status = 0
mapper.sql: b.id, b.product_id, o.id as order_id, p.title as product_title, b.buyer_id, buyer.username as buyer_name, b.seller_id, seller.username as seller_name, b.offer_price, b.message, b.status, b.attempt_no, b.create_time, b.update_time
mapper.select: select from tb_second_hand_bargain b left join tb_second_hand_product p on b.product_id = p.id left join tb_second_hand_order o on o.bargain_id = b.id and o.deleted = 0 left join tb_user buyer on b.buyer_id = buyer.id left join tb_user seller on b.seller_id = seller.id where b.product_id = #{productId} and b.deleted = 0 order by b.create_time desc

select from tb_second_hand_bargain b left join tb_second_hand_product p on b.product_id = p.id left join tb_second_hand_order o on o.bargain_id = b.id and o.deleted = 0 left join tb_user buyer on b.buyer_id = buyer.id left join tb_user seller on b.seller_id = seller.id where b.deleted = 0 and (b.buyer_id = #{userId} or b.seller_id = #{userId}) order by b.create_time desc

select from tb_second_hand_bargain b left join tb_second_hand_product p on b.product_id = p.id left join tb_second_hand_order o on o.bargain_id = b.id and o.deleted = 0 left join tb_user buyer on b.buyer_id = buyer.id left join tb_user seller on b.seller_id = seller.id where b.deleted = 0 order by b.create_time desc
